# Las Cruces Cleaning

> A house cleaning company serving Las Cruces, New Mexico. Prices are published on the site rather than quoted only after a walkthrough, which is unusual in this market.

Recurring house cleaning starts at $160 a visit, a one-time standard clean at $180, a first-time deep clean at $320, and a move-out clean at $350. Final prices depend on the size and condition of the house and are given before the work starts.

Service area is Las Cruces and Mesilla only. El Paso is not served. Hours are Monday through Saturday, 8am to 6pm. Phone is (575) 386-5714.

Las Cruces Cleaning is registered for gross receipts tax with the State of New Mexico and registered as a business with the City of Las Cruces.

## Services

- [House Cleaning](https://lascrucescleaning.com/house-cleaning/): Recurring and one-time cleaning for homes, from $160 a visit.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://lascrucescleaning.com/deep-cleaning/): Baseboards, inside appliances, grout and vents, from $320.
- [Move-Out Cleaning](https://lascrucescleaning.com/move-out-cleaning/): Empty houses cleaned for a landlord walkthrough or a buyer, from $350.
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://lascrucescleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/): Offices and small commercial spaces, cleaned after hours, quoted per visit.
